notes: Allowlisted production-dependency advisories. Every entry needs an owner, a concrete mitigation and an expiry date; the CI gate fails on new advisories or expired entries.

entries.reason: Nest 10 bundles vulnerable body-parser/multer; the fix requires the Nest 11/12 major upgrade.
entries.mitigation: BODY_LIMIT enforced in main.ts, multipart request cap + multer limits in src/common/uploads, and no upload endpoints are exposed.

entries.reason: Transitive through @nestjs/platform-express 10 (fixed only in the Nest 12 line).
entries.mitigation: Explicit json/urlencoded limits (BODY_LIMIT, default 1mb) configured before Nest boots.

entries.reason: Transitive through @nestjs/platform-express 10; DoS advisories fixed in newer multer majors.
entries.mitigation: No upload routes today; future routes must use buildMulterOptions() (fileSize/files/fields/parts caps + MIME allowlist) and multipartLimitMiddleware() rejects oversized payloads with 413.

entries.reason: Only reachable through @nestjs/swagger's document generator; fix requires Swagger 12 (breaking).
entries.mitigation: Swagger UI/document generation is disabled when NODE_ENV=production (main.ts), so the parser is not reachable in production.

entries.reason: Only reachable through @nestjs/swagger; fix requires Swagger 12 (breaking).
entries.mitigation: Swagger is non-production only; no application code imports lodash directly.

entries.reason: JaegerPropagator throws on malformed headers (DoS); fixed in the OTel 0.300 line.
entries.mitigation: The SDK uses the default W3C trace-context/baggage propagators; Jaeger propagation is not configured, so untrusted headers never reach JaegerPropagator.

entries.reason: Pulls the vulnerable @opentelemetry/core / propagator-jaeger chain; fixed in the OTel 0.300 line.
entries.mitigation: Same as above: no Jaeger propagator configured, tracing stays on W3C propagators.
